input.quote: 13.3 Customer may transfer its licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24. Vendor shall not revoke or suspend a licence except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure.
input.rationale: The licence provisions meet the preferred position in full. Section 13.1 grants the subscription access rights to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf" (no notice condition required), and Section 13.2 grants Customer and its Affiliates a "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence" for paid-up software and Vendor Technology, with contractor support expressly permitted. Section 13.3 bars Vendor from revoking or suspending any licence except for a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity, so the subscription licence is not revocable at will, and it permits transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24, which Section 24.1 allows without Vendor consent for M&A successors. Section 9 gives Vendor termination rights only for material breach and Section 10 preserves paid-up licences after expiry, so nothing elsewhere undercuts the grant. No redline required.
